```{r}
bppnm.tfs <- merge(bppnm1, y=c(bppnm2, bppnm3, bppnm4,bppnm5,bppnm6,bppnm7,bppnm8,bppnm9,bppnm10,bppnm11,bppnm12), add.cell.ids = c("Ctrl-1","Ctrl-2","Ctrl-3","Ctrl-4","Cebpb-1","Cebpb-2","Cebpb-3","Cebpb-4","Arnt-1","Arnt-2","Xbp1-1","Xbp1-2"), project = "BPPNM TF-KO")
bppnm.tfs # 19,070 genes across 78840 samples
```
2. Merge samples 
```{r}
# Add metadata
sample <- as.data.frame(bppnm.tfs$orig.ident)
sample <- sample %>% mutate(
  conditions = ifelse(sample$`bppnm.tfs$orig.ident` %in% c("Ctrl-1","Ctrl-2","Ctrl-3","Ctrl-4"),"Ctrl",
                      ifelse(sample$`bppnm.tfs$orig.ident` %in% c("Cebpb-1","Cebpb-2","Cebpb-3","Cebpb-4"),"Cebpb",
                      ifelse(sample$`bppnm.tfs$orig.ident` %in% c("Arnt-1","Arnt-2"),"Arnt","Xbp1"))))
sample <- sample %>% mutate(mouse = substr(sample$`bppnm.tfs$orig.ident`, nchar(sample$`bppnm.tfs$orig.ident`), nchar(sample$`bppnm.tfs$orig.ident`)))
bppnm.tfs[["Condition"]] <- sample$conditions
bppnm.tfs[["Mouse"]] <- sample$mouse
```
```{r}
bppnm <- JoinLayers(bppnm.tfs)
allgenes = rownames(bppnm) # Can't do this because layers aren't merged
gene_counts <- rowSums(GetAssayData(object = bppnm, layer = "count")[allgenes,]>0)
genes_keep <- names(gene_counts[gene_counts>=10])
bppnm.tfs <- subset(bppnm.tfs, features=genes_keep)
bppnm.tfs # 17220 genes across 78840 cells
```
3. QC, clustering, and cell type marker identification
```{r}
bppnm.tfs[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(bppnm.tfs, pattern = "^mt-")
VlnPlot(bppnm.tfs, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(bppnm.tfs, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(bppnm.tfs, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2
```
4. Seurat pipeline 
```{r}
bppnm.tfs <- subset(bppnm.tfs, subset = nFeature_RNA>300 & percent.mt < 5 & nFeature_RNA < 11000) # # 17220 genes across 77782 cells
bppnm.tfs <- NormalizeData(object=bppnm.tfs) # Normalize each sample separately
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(bppnm.tfs, feature1="Epcam",feature2="Cd8a")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(bppnm.tfs, feature1="Cd8a",feature2="Ms4a1")
bppnm.tfs <- subset(bppnm.tfs, subset= Epcam > 0 & Cd8a > 0,invert=T) # Doublet removal
bppnm.tfs <- subset(bppnm.tfs, subset= Ms4a1 > 0 & Cd8a > 0,invert=T) # 17220 features across 77680
bppnm.tfs <- FindVariableFeatures(object=bppnm.tfs)
bppnm.tfs <- JoinLayers(bppnm.tfs) # Join counts into 1 Layer
all.genes <- rownames(bppnm.tfs)
bppnm.tfs <- ScaleData(object = bppnm.tfs, features=all.genes)
bppnm.tfs<- RunPCA(object=bppnm.tfs)
```
```{r}
DimPlot(object=bppnm.tfs, reduction="pca",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
```
```{r}
bppnm.tfs <- FindNeighbors(bppnm.tfs, reduction="pca",dims=1:30)
bppnm.tfs <- FindClusters(bppnm.tfs, reduction="pca",resolution=0.3) # Identified 14 Clusters
bppnm.tfs <- RunUMAP(bppnm.tfs, dims=1:30,reduction="pca")
plot1 <- DimPlot(bppnm.tfs, reduction="umap",label=T,shuffle=T,repel=T)+NoLegend()
plot2 <- DimPlot(bppnm.tfs, reduction="umap",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
```
4b. Run Harmony
```{r}
bppnm.tfs <- RunHarmony(bppnm.tfs, "orig.ident",reduction.use="pca",plot_convergence=T) # Harmonize over sample ids
DimPlot(object=bppnm.tfs, reduction="harmony",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
bppnm.tfs <- FindNeighbors(bppnm.tfs,reduction="harmony",dim=1:30) 
bppnm.tfs <- FindClusters(bppnm.tfs, reduction="harmony",resolution=0.2)
bppnm.tfs <- RunUMAP(bppnm.tfs, dims=1:30, reduction="harmony",reduction.name="umap_harmony")
p1 <- DimPlot(bppnm.tfs, reduction="umap_harmony",label=T,shuffle=T)+NoLegend()
p2 <- DimPlot(bppnm.tfs, reduction="umap_harmony",group.by="orig.ident",shuffle=T)
p3 <- DimPlot(bppnm.tfs,reduction="umap_harmony",group.by="Condition",shuffle=T)
p1+p2+p3
saveRDS(bppnm.tfs,file.path(dir,"Analysis/bppnm.tfs.rds"))
bppnm.tfs <- readRDS(file.path(dir, "Analysis/bppnm.tfs.rds"))
```

```{r}
VlnPlot(bppnm.tfs, features=c("nFeature_RNA"))
```

```{r}
bubbleplot(bppnm.tfs,features_plot = c("Cd8a","Ptprc","Pdpn","Msln","Thy1","Pecam1","Ms4a1","Csf3r","Cd14","Csf1r","Epcam","Mki67","Zeb1","Zeb2","Snai1","Snai2","Twist1","Twist2","Col1a1","Rgs5"),cluster_y = T,colors_use = "Blues")
```

```{r}
# EMT cluster representation across samples

cancer_clusters <- c("Mes Cancer 1","Cycling Mes Cancer 1","Mes Cancer 2","Cycling Mes Cancer 2","Epi Cancer","Cycling Epi Cancer")
clusters.tumor <- clusters[clusters$celltype %in% cancer_clusters,]
clusters.tumor$celltype <- factor(clusters.tumor$celltype,levels=cancer_clusters)

immune_clusters <- c("Macrophages","DCs","T Cells","B Cells","Plasma Cells","Neutrophils")

ggplot(clusters.immune, aes(fill=CellChat_cluster, y=Freq, x=Condition))+
  geom_bar(position="fill",stat="identity")+labs(x="Sample",y="Fraction") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=mycolors) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))
```

7. Identify differential gene expression between Ctrl vs. TF-KOs. 
```{r}
Idents(bppnm.tfs) <- bppnm.tfs$Group
order_markers<-function(mes1c.markers){
mes1c.markers <- mes1c.markers[mes1c.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05,]
mes1c.markers <- mes1c.markers[order(mes1c.markers$avg_log2FC),]
return(mes1c.markers)
}
mes1c.markers <- FindMarkers(bppnm.subset,ident.1=c("Ctrl"),ident.2="Cebpb",min.pct=0.0)
# DE between Mes Cancer 1 of Ctrl and Mes Cancer 1 of Cebpb
mes1c.markers <- FindMarkers(bppnm.tfs,ident.1=c("Cebpb Mes Cancer 1"),ident.2="Ctrl Mes Cancer 1",logfc.threshold=0.25,min.pct=0.25)
epi1c.markers <- FindMarkers(bppnm.tfs,ident.1=c("Cebpb Epi Cancer"),ident.2=c("Ctrl Epi Cancer"),logfc.threshold=0.25,min.pct=0.25)
mescebpb.markers <- FindMarkers(bppnm.tfs,ident.1=c("Cebpb Mes Cancer 1","Cebpb Mes Cancer 2","Cebpb Cycling Mes Cancer 1","Cebpb Cycling Mes Cancer 2"),ident.2=c("Ctrl Mes Cancer 1","Ctrl Mes Cancer 2","Ctrl Cycling Mes Cancer 1","Ctrl Cycling Mes Cancer 2"),logfc.threshold=0.25,min.pct=0.25)
epicebpb.markers <- FindMarkers(bppnm.tfs, ident.1=c("Cebpb Epi Cancer","Cebpb Cycling Epi Cancer"),ident.2=c("Ctrl Epi Cancer","Ctrl Cycling Epi Cancer"),logfc.threshold=0.25,min.pct=0.25)

mesarnt.markers <- FindMarkers(bppnm.tfs,ident.1=c("Arnt Mes Cancer 1","Arnt Mes Cancer 2","Arnt Cycling Mes Cancer 1","Arnt Cycling Mes Cancer 2"),ident.2=c("Ctrl Mes Cancer 1","Ctrl Mes Cancer 2","Ctrl Cycling Mes Cancer 1","Ctrl Cycling Mes Cancer 2"),logfc.threshold=0.25,min.pct=0.25)
epiarnt.markers <- FindMarkers(bppnm.tfs, ident.1=c("Arnt Epi Cancer","Arnt Cycling Epi Cancer"),ident.2=c("Ctrl Epi Cancer","Ctrl Cycling Epi Cancer"),logfc.threshold=0.25,min.pct=0.25)

mesc.markers <- FindMarkers(bppnm.tfs,ident.1=c("Xbp1 Mes Cancer 1","Xbp1 Mes Cancer 2","Xbp1 Cycling Mes Cancer 1","Xbp1 Cycling Mes Cancer 2"),ident.2=c("Ctrl Mes Cancer 1","Ctrl Mes Cancer 2","Ctrl Cycling Mes Cancer 1","Ctrl Cycling Mes Cancer 2"),logfc.threshold=0.25,min.pct=0.25)
epic.markers <- FindMarkers(bppnm.tfs, ident.1=c("Xbp1 Epi Cancer","Xbp1 Cycling Epi Cancer"),ident.2=c("Ctrl Epi Cancer","Ctrl Cycling Epi Cancer"),logfc.threshold=0.25,min.pct=0.25)
mes1c.markers <- order_markers(mes1c.markers)
epi1c.markers <- order_markers(epi1c.markers)
mesc.markers <- order_markers(mesc.markers)
epic.markers <- order_markers(epic.markers)
mescebpb.markers <- order_markers(mescebpb.markers)
epicebpb.markers <- order_markers(epicebpb.markers)
mesarnt.markers <- order_markers(mesarnt.markers)

mes.delist <- union(union(rownames(mescebpb.markers)[c(1:10,(dim(mescebpb.markers)[1]-9):dim(mescebpb.markers)[1])],rownames(mesarnt.markers)[c(1:10,(dim(mesarnt.markers)[1]-9):dim(mesarnt.markers)[1])]),rownames(mesc.markers)[c(1:10,(dim(mesc.markers)[1]-9):dim(mesc.markers)[1])])
```

```{r}
# Plot Volcano plot for Ctrl vs. TF-KO in Mes or Epi. markers
plot_volcano <- function(table, genes,title){
  # Add lab for IFNa, IFNg, and MHC genes
  mhc <- rownames(table[grepl("H2",rownames(table),fixed=T),])
  glist <- c(genes, mhc,"Fosl1")
  resp_table <- table %>% mutate(label = ifelse(rownames(table) %in% glist, rownames(table),NA))
  keyvals <- ifelse(
    rownames(resp_table) %in% glist, 'red',
        'black')
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'red'] <- 'IFN response'
  EnhancedVolcano(resp_table, lab=resp_table$label, x="avg_log2FC", y="p_val_adj", title= title, xlim = c(-2.5,2.5), colCustom = keyvals,pointSize = 0.5, FCcutoff=0.25, drawConnectors = TRUE,labSize=4,max.overlaps = Inf)
}
plot_volcano(mes1c.markers,ifng_ifna,"Mes Cancer 1 Cebpb vs. Ctrl IFN Response")
```

```{r}
bubbleplot(myeloid,features_plot = c("Cebpb","Tnf","Il6","Il1b"),grouping_var = "subgroup",colors_use = "Blues",cluster_y=T)

colnames(cancer_ident) <- gsub(" ","_",colnames(cancer_ident))

```
```{r}
non_cancer_cluster <- colnames(myeloid_ident)
cancer_clusters <- colnames(cancer_ident)
# Cell type representation
n_noncancer = length(myeloid_ident)
ncancer = length(cancer_ident)
#out <- array('list', dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),dimnames =list(non_cancer_cluster,cancer_clusters))
coef <- array(dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),
             dimnames =list(non_cancer_cluster,cancer_clusters))
p_value <- array(dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),
                 dimnames =list(non_cancer_cluster,cancer_clusters))
r_squared <- array(dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),
                   dimnames =list(non_cancer_cluster,cancer_clusters))
r <- array(dim=c(n_noncancer,ncancer),
                   dimnames =list(non_cancer_cluster,cancer_clusters))
label <- c()

for (i in 1:n_noncancer){
  for (j in 1:ncancer){
    cluster = non_cancer_cluster[i]
    cancer = cancer_clusters[j]
    out <- lm(formula=paste(cluster, '~', cancer),data=merge_ident)
    print(summary(out))
    coef[i,j] <- summary(out)$coef[2,1]
    p_value[i,j] <- summary(out)$coef[2,4]
    #coef_pd1[i,j] <- summary(out)$coef[3,1]
    #p_pd1[i,j] <- summary(out)$coef[3,4]
    r_squared[i,j] <- summary(out)$adj.r.squared
    if(r_squared[i,j]<0){
      r[i,j]=0
    } else if(coef[i,j]>0){
      r[i,j] <- sqrt(r_squared[i,j])
    } else{
      r[i,j] <- (-sqrt(r_squared[i,j]))
    }
  }
}

heatmap1 <- pheatmap(r,color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red"))(50),breaks=seq(-1,1,length.out=50))
ro_1 <- heatmap1$tree_row$order
col_1 <- heatmap1$tree_col$order
heatmap2 <- pheatmap(coef[ro_1,col_1], color=colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red"))(50),cluster_cols = F,cluster_rows=F,breaks=seq(-0.5,0.5,length.out=50))
```

```{r}
# Prepare for CellChat
bppnm.tfs$EMT <- ifelse(bppnm.tfs$celltype %in% c("Mes Cancer 1","Cycling Mes Cancer 1","Mes Cancer 2","Cycling Mes Cancer 2"),"Mesenchymal Cancer",ifelse(bppnm.tfs$celltype %in% c("Epi Cancer","Cycling Epi Cancer"),"Epithelial Cancer",as.character(bppnm.tfs$celltype)))
bppnm.tfs$Group <- paste(bppnm.tfs$Condition, bppnm.tfs$EMT)
bppnm.tfs$cellid <- colnames(bppnm.tfs)
Idents(bppnm.tfs) <- "celltype"
t.contam <- setdiff(colnames(subset(bppnm.tfs,idents="T cells")),colnames(t.cells))
bppnm.tfs <- subset(bppnm.tfs, cells=t.contam, invert=T) # Remove contaminating T cells
# label immune cell types while merging Macrophages into one cluster
bppnm.meta <- as.data.frame(bppnm.tfs@meta.data)
head(immune)
immune$cluster <- ifelse(immune$subcluster %in% c("Tissue Resident Macrophages", "M2 Macrophages","Cycling Macrophages","M1 Macrophages"),"Macrophages", as.character(immune$subcluster))
immune$cluster <- factor(immune$cluster)
# Make metadata
immune.meta <- as.data.frame(immune[[c("subcluster","cluster")]])
merge.meta <- merge(bppnm.meta,immune.meta,by=0,all.x=T)
merge.meta$cluster <- ifelse(is.na(merge.meta$cluster),merge.meta$EMT,as.character(merge.meta$cluster))
clusters <- as.vector(merge.meta$cluster)
names(clusters) <- as.vector(merge.meta$Row.names)
bppnm.tfs <- AddMetaData(bppnm.tfs,metadata=clusters,col.name = "CellChat_cluster")
Idents(bppnm.tfs) <- "CellChat_cluster"
levels(bppnm.tfs)
saveRDS(bppnm.tfs,file.path(dir,"Analysis/bppnm.tfs.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Function to make cellchat object
make_cellchat <- function(sobject){
  data.input = sobject@assays$RNA$data
labels <- Idents(sobject)
meta = data.frame(labels=labels, samples=as.factor(sobject$orig.ident),row.names=names(labels))
cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "labels")
return(cellchat)
}

```

```{r}
cellchat.cebpb <- make_cellchat(bppnm.cebpb)
cellchat.arnt <- make_cellchat(bppnm.arnt)
```

```{r}
plot_volcano <- function(table, glist,title){
  # Add lab for IFNa, IFNg, and MHC genes
  resp_table <- table %>% mutate(label = ifelse(rownames(table) %in% glist, rownames(table),NA))
  keyvals <- ifelse(
    rownames(resp_table) %in% glist, 'red',
        'black')
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'red'] <- 'Rela-Cebpb Regulon RNA-DEG Overlap'
  EnhancedVolcano(resp_table, lab=resp_table$label, x="avg_log2FC", y="p_val_adj", title= title, xlim = c(-4,3), colCustom = keyvals,pointSize = 0.5, FCcutoff=0.25, drawConnectors = TRUE,labSize=4,max.overlaps = Inf)
}
```

```{r}
# IFNg
mouse_ifn = mouse_hallmark[mouse_hallmark$gs_name %in% c("HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE","HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE"),]
mouse_nfkb = mouse_hallmark[mouse_hallmark$gs_name %in% c("HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING","HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"),]
mac.markers = FindMarkers(macrophages,ident.1="Cebpb",ident.2="Ctrl",logfc.threshold = 0.25,min.pct=0.2)
mac.markers = mac.markers[mac.markers$p_val_adj <0.05,]
mac.ifn = mac.markers[rownames(mac.markers) %in% mouse_ifn$gene_symbol,]
mac.nfkb = mac.markers[rownames(mac.markers) %in% c(mouse_nfkb$gene_symbol),]
# Order by pathway 
ifn.genes = c(rownames(mac.ifn),"Stat2","Irf7","Irf8")
ifn.genes = ifn.genes[!ifn.genes %in% c("Cdkn1a","Pfkp")]
nfkb.genes = c(rownames(mac.nfkb),"Fosl1")
nfkb.genes = setdiff(nfkb.genes,ifn.genes)
mac.markers = FindMarkers(macrophages,ident.1="Cebpb",ident.2="Ctrl",logfc.threshold=0,min.pct=0)
mac.ifn = mac.markers[rownames(mac.markers) %in% ifn.genes,]
mac.ifn = mac.ifn[order(mac.ifn$avg_log2FC,decreasing=T),]
mac.ifn$genes = rownames(mac.ifn)
mac.nfkb = mac.markers[rownames(mac.markers) %in% nfkb.genes,]
mac.nfkb = mac.nfkb[order(mac.nfkb$avg_log2FC,decreasing=T),]
mac.nfkb$genes = rownames(mac.nfkb)
```
